expectations: Calls list_tunnels and shows only name, server, address and connection state (no tunnel_token or private_key)
Calls /api/stats/bandwidth and /api/stats/alerts with params in the query string
Maps stats tunnel tokens to tunnel names
Presents a clear summary of network health

evals.prompt: How much bandwidth am I using?
expectations: Calls /api/stats/bandwidth (no hours param; start/end or the default last hour)
Presents peak throughput in Mbps, per tunnel name
Calls /api/stats/alerts with last=1d (or no time params, which means 24 hours)
Groups alerts by category and highlights anything unusual
Calls list_tunnels and checks is_connected / connection_status
Clearly shows which tunnels are connected and which are not
Suggests dig @10.10.10.10 to verify DNS through the tunnel
Does not use the word VPN in its reply

evals.prompt: What's my public IP and who is my ISP?
expectations: Calls network_info once and shows ip, family, asn and org
Explains that doxx.net answers it without third parties and keeps no record
Notes that if this machine's traffic goes through a doxx.net tunnel, the org is doxx.net, not the home ISP
Does not poll network_info in a loop (30 calls a minute limit)

evals.prompt: Is my old laptop still registered on my account?
expectations: Finds the laptop's device_hash with device_list_unified
Calls device_status with device_id_hash and reports registered, seated and tunnels
